title: B Department Operations Support
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSEA > NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER > NSWC DAHLGREN
description: This is the formal Request for Proposals (RFP) for Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division (NSWCDD) Electromagnetic and Sensor Systems Department (B) Operations Support Services. This requirement is a Small Business Set-Aside for SeaPort-NxG MAC holders only. Proposals shall be submitted in accordance with the instructions detailed in the RFP and should be sent directly via the PIEE Solicitation Module.
